messages.subject: Weighted response variable?
parts:
Hi all,

I'm working on a problem where I'm trying to model something where the response variable is derived from another model (assume I have no access to it) and so the response has it's own uncertainty.  I'd like to incorporate that as weights like 1/sig^2. 

I played around with inla.setOption("enable.inla.argument.weights", TRUE), and so the warning play out that the marginal intervals make no sense (very small), and so I conclude I don't know what I'm doing.

Advice on how to deal with this not-unusual problem?

Thanks,

--Mike

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Weighted response variable?
parts:
There is this option named ‘scale’ that might might be what you want, see

  inla.doc(‘gaussian’, section=‘likelihood')

--
